metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (-41.729403, -125.410394), 100km radius buffer - Periods: Nov 2019 - Feb 2020 vs Nov 2018 - Feb 2019 - Collection: Sentinel-5P with chlorophyll data (or use ocean color data like MODIS) - Sentinel-5P has TROPOMI instrument with O3, NO2, etc., but not direct chlorophyll - Better option: MODIS Terra/Aqua has chlorophyll concentration (MOD09 or MODIS ocean color) - Alternative: Copernicus Sentinel-3 OLCI for ocean color chlorophyll 2. Masking strategy: - Chlorophyll data typically comes pre-processed - May need to filter by QA/validity flags - Remove pixels with -999 or NoData values 3. Logic: - Calculate mean chlorophyll for Nov 2019 - Feb 2020 - Calculate mean chlorophyll for Nov 2018 - Feb 2019 - Compare: if 2019-2020 > 2018-2019, answer is A (Yes, up) - If 2019-2020 <= 2018-2019, answer is B (No, not up) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
lon, lat = -125.410394, -41.729403
point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat])
geom = point.buffer(100000)  # 100km radius

# Period 1: Nov 2019 - Feb 2020
start_2019 = '2019-11-01'
end_2020 = '2020-02-29'

# Period 2: Nov 2018 - Feb 2019
start_2018 = '2018-11-01'
end_2019 = '2019-02-28'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Chlorophyll
# MODIS AQUA has MOD09 surface reflectance; use MODIS corrected reflectance for chlorophyll estimation
# Better: Use COPERNICUS/S5P or MODIS ocean color product
# Actually, use Sentinel-3 OLCI or MODIS with chlorophyll bands

# Try MODIS AQUA corrected reflectance (has chlorophyll-sensitive bands)
col_2019_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD09GA') \
    .filterBounds(geom) \
    .filterDate(start_2019, end_2020) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50))

col_2018_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD09GA') \
    .filterBounds(geom) \
    .filterDate(start_2018, end_2019) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50))

size_2019_2020 = col_2019_2020.size().getInfo()
size_2018_2019 = col_2018_2019.size().getInfo()

print(f"Nov 2019-Feb 2020 images: {size_2019_2020}")
print(f"Nov 2018-Feb 2019 images: {size_2018_2019}")

if size_2019_2020 == 0 or size_2018_2019 == 0:
    print("Trying Sentinel-3 OLCI for ocean chlorophyll...")
    # Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-2 WRR
    col_2019_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S3/OLCI') \
        .filterBounds(geom) \
        .filterDate(start_2019, end_2020)
    
    col_2018_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S3/OLCI') \
        .filterBounds(geom) \
        .filterDate(start_2018, end_2019)
    
    size_2019_2020 = col_2019_2020.size().getInfo()
    size_2018_2019 = col_2018_2019.size().getInfo()
    
    print(f"S3 OLCI Nov 2019-Feb 2020: {size_2019_2020}")
    print(f"S3 OLCI Nov 2018-Feb 2019: {size_2018_2019}")
    
    if size_2019_2020 == 0 or size_2018_2019 == 0:
        print("No data found for specified periods.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Use CHL_OA band (chlorophyll concentration)
        img_2019_2020 = col_2019_2020.select('CHL_OA').mean()
        img_2018_2019 = col_2018_2019.select('CHL_OA').mean()
        
        # Count valid pixels
        count_2019_2020 = img_2019_2020.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=geom,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('CHL_OA').getInfo()
        
        count_2018_2019 = img_2018_2019.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=geom,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('CHL_OA').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Valid pixels 2019-2020: {count_2019_2020}")
        print(f"Valid pixels 2018-2019: {count_2018_2019}")
        
        if count_2019_2020 == 0 or count_2018_2019 == 0:
            print("No valid chlorophyll pixels after filtering.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            # Calculate mean chlorophyll
            mean_2019_2020 = img_2019_2020.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=geom,
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('CHL_OA').getInfo()
            
            mean_2018_2019 = img_2018_2019.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=geom,
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('CHL_OA').getInfo()
            
            print(f"Mean Chlorophyll Nov 2019-Feb 2020: {mean_2019_2020:.4f} mg/m^3")
            print(f"Mean Chlorophyll Nov 2018-Feb 2019: {mean_2018_2019:.4f} mg/m^3")
            
            if mean_2019_2020 is None or mean_2018_2019 is None:
                print("Calculation returned None.")
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif mean_2019_2020 > mean_2018_2019:
                print(f"Increase: {mean_2019_2020 - mean_2018_2019:.4f} mg/m^3")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print(f"Change: {mean_2019_2020 - mean_2018_2019:.4f} mg/m^3")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    # Process MODIS data (use bands 1-2 for chlorophyll proxy via red/NIR)
    img_2019_2020 = col_2019_2020.select(['sur_refl_b01']).mean()
    img_2018_2019 = col_2018_2019.select(['sur_refl_b01']).mean()
    
    count_2019_2020 = img_2019_2020.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    count_2018_2019 = img_2018_2019.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    if count_2019_2020 == 0 or count_2018_2019 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after filtering.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        mean_2019_2020 = img_2019_2020.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=geom,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        mean_2018_2019 = img_2018_2019.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=geom,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Mean Reflectance 2019-2020: {mean_2019_2020:.4f}")
        print(f"Mean Reflectance 2018-2019: {mean_2018_2019:.4f}")
        
        if mean_2019_2020 is None or mean_2018_2019 is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif mean_2019_2020 > mean_2018_2019:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
